seats.notes: Black-green midrange: cheap removal (Dead Weight, Bump, Tribute to Hunger), Typhoid-style early bodies, Festerhide-style fat, and fliers (Screeching Bat, Reaper). Cut the red, white, blue and equipment cards, and keep 17 lands since the top end includes 5-drops and a 7-drop.

White-red aggro-midrange: white is deepest with removal (Fiend Hunter, Smite, Bonds of Faith) and fliers, backed by red burn and evasive Vampires/Marauders. Cut Butcher's Cleaver and the weaker red/colorless cards for a low curve with 17 lands.

…x2, Smite, Ghostly Possession, Blazing Torch), fliers (Chapel Geist, Stitched Drake, Murder of Crows, Abbey Griffin, Mindshrieker), and a 2-3 drop curve. Cut Paraselene, Hysterical Blindness, Hauberk, Stony Silence, Ghost Quarter and Grotto for 17 basics (9 Plains, 8 Island) to reach 40 cards.

Mono-red aggro with 23 spells: cheap red creatures, Pitchburn Devils, Kessig Wolves and Village Ironsmiths, plus removal (Geistflame, Harvest Pyre, Into the Maw) and Ancient Grudge for artifacts. Blue is too thin to splash, so the deck stays red with 17 Mountains.

Green-black midrange: cheap removal (Victim of Night, Corpse Lunge, Prey Upon, Naturalize), Typhoid-style early drops, and big green bodies to break stalls. Cut the red cards, sacrifice-cost spells, and the weak Wreath/Curse cards; 16 lands because the curve is low.

…deck with Bloodline Keeper as the bomb, plus Fiend Hunter and Elder Cathar for removal and bodies. Cut the weaker off-color and marginal cards (Ghostly Possession, Rally, Urgent Exorcism, the second Unruly Mob and Bitterheart Witch), and run 10 Plains and 7 Swamps since white is much deeper.

…bodies (Typhoid Rats, Manor Skeleton, Orchard Spirit), and green/black fatties and fliers (Festerhide Boar, Somberwald Spider, Kindercatch, Falkenrath Noble). Cut red entirely, plus Tree of Redemption, Make a Wish, and Ranger's Guile; 17 lands because Kindercatch and the 5-drops push the curve up.

Blue-black control: cheap blockers, Sensory Deprivation and Grasp of Phantoms for removal, Liliana and card draw for advantage. Cut the red, green, and white cards, plus the weaker Frightful Delusion, Hysterical Blindness, and Altar's Reap.
